title: Sedation assessment

sources.use: PADIS 2018 and 2025 focused update: recommendation statements; licence RED/unverified

objectives: Assess pain and sedation with validated tools at the ordered frequency.
Record the target and actual score and report persistent deviation.
Take part in daily awakening trials safely when ordered.

items.text: Perform the daily sedation interruption or spontaneous awakening trial when ordered and the patient is suitable, with team safety checks; watch for agitation, distress, desaturation or haemodynamic change and follow the protocol for stopping or restarting.
Assess at the ordered frequency with validated tools; record the target and actual score; report persistent deviation; reassess after every dose change and procedure.
Where a protocol allows, titrate sedatives to the prescribed target score (nurse-protocolised targeted sedation).
Titration authority is set by order or protocol; doses are not given in this library.
Scale level definitions (RASS, SAS) are not reproduced; use the unit-approved tool and its training.
Record scores, target and trend; reassess after any change.
Report persistent deviation from target, agitation or over-sedation.
Record tool, score, target, interventions and response per your unit's documentation standard.

checklist.text: Use the unit's validated tool and record target and actual score.
Assess pain as well as sedation.
Titrate only within the order or protocol.
Reassess after every dose change and procedure.
Report persistent deviation, agitation or over-sedation.

gaps: RASS/SAS definitions, dosing, neuromuscular blockade: not covered.
PADIS full text: recommendation statements only.
